description: Type notificationConfigs.insert's HTTP 400 for a topic the Cloud Storage service agent cannot publish to ('Cloud Pub/Sub topic '...' not found, or user 'service-N@gs-project-accounts...' does not have permission to it.'). It surfaced as a generic BadRequest, so callers matched on the message to wait out IAM propagation after granting roles/pubsub.publisher.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The Pub/Sub topic does not exist or the bucket's Cloud Storage service agent may not publish to it (HTTP 400). Retryable while a fresh roles/pubsub.publisher grant propagates.
